directory.description: Positively observed working directory; null when the source cannot currently be observed.

discovery_warnings.description: Discovery limitations, including incomplete optional native enrichment. Does not establish runtime readiness.

previous_conversation_ids.description: Native conversations this entry continued from (verified continued-in markers), oldest first.

display_name.description: Revision 11: optional display name; id/name/home never change on rename.
